title: Record one-clock client latency markers
evidence_required: FT-003-AC-010 RED: the client lifecycle has no one-clock markers; GREEN: one client monotonic origin records ready-series, local-detection-complete, request-start and response-receipt markers, serializes the accepted correlation timestamp/offsets through TASK-052's existing seam, and produces non-negative ordered durations with local_detection_completed_ms <= request_started_ms; decisive comparison: controlled fixture clock and real-browser runs reconcile marker order/durations without subtracting client/server wall clocks; artifact: marker logs and Playwright transcript under .tasks/TASK-066-T2-FT-003-W5/.
purpose: Own client monotonic marker collection/reconciliation independently of request serialization.
success_outcome: The client contributes trustworthy one-clock ready-to-response timing to the later joint 19/20 acceptance.
anti_goals: Do not form/validate multipart requests or own server latency.
Do not implement diagnostic UI owned by FT-007.
Do not subtract client and server wall clocks or claim final QR latency.

stop_conditions: Markers cannot share one client monotonic origin.

constraints: Use installed playwright cli with controlled and real client clocks.
Keep RFC3339 correlation timestamp distinct from monotonic offsets.
Retain marker logs under the task directory.
invariants: All duration markers share one client monotonic clock.

verification_targets: Serialization integration through TASK-052 seam without re-owning AC-015.
Evidence is joinable to later controlled attempt IDs.
